records.name: Hibernation & Sleep

registry-helper.reads: Missing, wrong type or read exception becomes null.
registry-helper.set: Creates missing key; sets explicit type; catches failure and returnsfalse.
registry-helper.delete: Opens existing key only; missing key/value is success; catches failure.
registry-helper.verifiedSet: Write result then DWORD equality readback.
registry-helper.verifiedDelete: Delete then nullable DWORD absence; a present non-DWORD value may be mistaken for absent.
registry-helper.nativeProcess: Starts hidden without shell, waits up to timeout, returns exitCode==0; exceptions=>false. No kill on timeout. Many callers ignore returnedfalse.

registry-acl-helper.ordinarySet: Open existing key writable; absent key=>false with no creation.
registry-acl-helper.undo: Prior owner/DACL are not stored or restored. Independent implementation must not silently reproduce this side effect.

core-isolation-registry.delete: HKLM existing key deletion; catches errors.
core-isolation-registry.native: BCD waits10s, PowerShell60s; exception caught, exit status ignored.

service-control.startup: TrySetDword Start first, including ACL fallback; failure=>sc.exe config start=boot/system/auto/demand/disabled.
service-control.start: Already Running=>success; if Disabled change to Manual; ServiceController.Start and10s wait; exception=>sc.exe start.
service-control.stop: Already Stopped=>success; stop only if CanStop,10s wait; exception=>sc.exe stop.
service-control.restart: Stop followed by Start even if stop fails.
service-control.serviceBatch: Absent services skipped; startup changed; Disabled => stop, Automatic => start, Manual/System/Boot=>no runtime action. Startup failures tracked separately from runtime restart-needed failures.
service-control.detection: Filter existing services; none=>Removed; no readable Start=>Unknown; all>=threshold=>Disabled; some>=threshold=>PartiallyEnabled; otherwise Enabled.

primary-network-adapters.realGateway: Not null, loopback, IPv4Any or IPv6Any
primary-network-adapters.physicalIdentity: HKLM SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Network\{4D36E972-E325-11CE-BFC1-08002BE10318}\<id>\Connection PnpInstanceID starts PCI\ or USB\
